description: Mark a group of questions handled (RESOLVED) or move it back to waiting (ESCALATED). It moves the whole group, sends nobody a message and returns { changed }, the number of conversations moved; 0 means the group was already there. MANAGER+ required.

questionId.description: A question group's id, from list_support_questions

status.description: RESOLVED marks the group handled; ESCALATED moves it back to waiting

name: set_support_question_status
